questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

(4, 2, 18)

(1, 7, 24)

(5, 4, ?)

(**NOTE:** Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(4, 2, 18)

(1, 7, 24)

(5, 4, ?)

**Logic:** **'Row wise'**

**First row → Third number = [(First **number** + Second **number**) × 3]**

**First row (4, 2, 18) →**

⇒ [(4 + 2) × 3]

⇒ (6 × 3) = 18

**Second row (1, 7, 24) →**

⇒ [(1 + 7) × 3]

⇒ (8 × 3) = 24

Similarly, for the third row (5, 4, ?) →

⇒ [(5 + 4) × 3]

⇒ (9 × 3) =** 27**

Here, the question mark(?) is replaced by** 27.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".

questions.question: In Five year plans, Plan Holiday is from ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1966-1969.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Plan Holiday:-**

 
 
• It​ was a **break** in the **Five Year Plans of India**, during which** no new plan** was launched.
 
• It was from** 1966 to 1969** when the **third plan ended** and the** fourth plan began.**
 
• The break was taken to evaluate the** progress** of the previous plans and to make **necessary changes **in the upcoming plan.
 
• The decision to take a Plan Holiday was made by the then** Prime Minister of India, Indira Gandhi.**
 
• The Plan Holiday helped in** improving the economy** and **reducing poverty **in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Five-Year Plans:-**

 
 
• **It refer to the country's series of comprehensive economic development strategies. **
 
• The planning process was initiated by the Planning Commission (and later replaced by NITI Aayog).
 
• Each plan outlined the government's priorities, sectoral allocations, and development goals for a five-year period.
 
• The concept of five-year plans was popularized by the Soviet Union under Joseph Stalin's leadership. The Soviets used these plans to rapidly industrialize and develop the economy.

• It is an example of an **indirect tax** because it is **not directly paid by the consumer** to the government, but rather collected by **businesses** and then** remitted** to the government.
 
• **GST** was introduced in India in **2017** to replace** multiple indirect taxes** such as **excise duty, service tax, and value-added tax (VAT).**
 
• The aim was to simplify the tax system and create a **single, unified tax structure.**
 
• The GST system has **different tax rates** for different goods and services, ranging from **0% to 28%.**
 
• There are four tax slabs **- 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28% -** with essential goods and services attracting lower rates and luxury items attracting higher rates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Transfer payment **is a type of payment made by the **government to individuals or organizations **without any goods or services being exchanged.

• Hence, the **correct **answer is option 4 - GST is an example of an indirect tax.

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let the total work is the 60 units (LCM of 30 and 20)

The efficiency of Supraja is 60 / 30 = 2 units

The efficiency of Kausalya is 60 / 20 = 3 units

In 2 days they do 3 + 2 = 5 units

__
 
• **"Joint"** means shared by two or more people or entities. (दो या अधिक लोगों की भागीदारी या स्‍वामित्‍व वाला; संयुक्त)

 
 
• **Example:** *They have a **joint**__ bank account.*
 
 
 
• It can be used as an adjective or a noun.
 
• In this passage, the word** "joint"** is used as an adjective as it is modifying the noun **"effort."**
 
• The correct answer is option 1.
 
• Correct passage: 

The __challenge__ of climate change is one of the most pressing issues facing the world today. Rising temperatures, extreme weather events and melting ice caps are just a few of the __consequences__ of a changing climate. To combat this, many countries have pledged to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions, but progress has been slow. In addition, some people are still sceptical of the __reality__ of climate change or believe that it's a natural occurrence that humans can't do much about. However, scientists agree that urgent action is needed to prevent the worst impacts of climate change. This includes not only reducing emissions but also adapting to the changes that have already __occurred__. This might involve building sea walls to protect against rising sea levels, planting drought-resistant crops or developing new technologies to remove carbon from the atmosphere. Ultimately, addressing climate change will require a __**joint**__ effort from individuals, governments and businesses around the world.

• **"Individual" **means relating to one person or entity. (समूह से अलग; अकेला)
